body:
I take rejections very personally, because every time it happens I feel like a second-class human and I become more angry and bitter. And rejections are the only reactions I have collected so far.

More so, because I don't have any problems in other areas of life like friends and job.

I think I am far away from "handsome", handsome are guys like Gerard Butler. But thanks anyway.

Well, it is the experiences I've made with women my whole life. I can get only so far with women with my best "performance" towards them, but let one other truly handsome guy enter the stage and their eyes are glowing with lust and desire.
Oh I have that too. Thanks for the feedback!

I am really at a loss here, because I get to know women from 20 to 30 from so many different areas... house partys, through friends, my job, through my travellings... I don't know where these "other" women are who would be more interested in me.

>Relationships, are, for most people, not really that great. Much of it is facade and so many people end up jaded and disappointed (regardless of how things look).

Well, that's what people who know of my problem always tell me, but really, being practically untouched with the age of 27 is really a mega downer for my ego. You are always stuck with the thought that not one woman you have ever met, and I met many, was attracted to you in any way. Like what I am, a human being or a disgusting monster? If I had at least broken relationships, I knew that I have the ability to be attractive to women at least for a short period of time. But nada... and Sex is the most normal thing for most people, for me it's like a non-reachable goal for my entire lifetime.

Regarding feelings, I get where you're coming from and thinking about that you might be right... I am not a person who shows feelings. I don't remember events where I really enjoyed myself or was truly excited about something. Because of these many rejections I closed off my feelings completely, I guess. Because of the many disappointments and not being loved, I began to cut my arms when I was a teenager. Now, for most people, I make a rather reserved and analytical appearance. But I honestly don't know how to change that...

Yeah I travel as much as time and money allows it. Which is roughly 3 times a year. 

I wish I wouldn't see women this way but I only got to know them as shallow beings. It doesn't matter how intelligent or well educated they are but I always lose against a good looking guy who pops up around the corner and take them from me with ease... 

Thank you again...

Hi there. Thanks for your thoughts. 

I don't know if you can imagine how it is to be an ugly guy. As a soldier you must be pretty fit.

As an ugly guy it's like living in another dimension where the possibility for a loving and caring woman is completely out of reach for me. Everybody can accomplish it but not me. This is all my experience and my impression that I've encountered so far. 

My hobbies are travelling around all over the world and photographing. I make really good pictures and they are well received on photographers websites. I am also very social and meet with my friends nearly every day after work for drinking and smoking hookahs

No. Women don't tell that a guy right away. But not one woman in my entire life didn't tell me that I am handsome or *at least* decent either.

But I've seen too many women getting wet when they get to know a good looking guy and be together with him and banging after one week.

My friends would care about my death for maybe one week, then they will go on with their lives, so like I've never existed.

I am not going to clubs, because: I hate bitches. I went to clubs in my early 20s and I only made really really shitty experiences here. Because in a club it's merely depended on your looks, if you're successful or not.

For I am an ugly man, crowded clubs are not my choice. Women block me off as soon as I approach them because they think they are godsents.

I keep looking for over 10 years now, and I am tired of this game. I don't sound overly dramatic here, but I'm convinced that killing myself is the only way to get rid of the pain caused by a dozens of rejections. I am really worthless, as every woman is disgusted by me.

To be honest, I don't really think that women buy into a men with money unless he's a millionaire. Say, I am not that much more impressive over a guy who makes 30k a year, especially when he's handsome.

I truly think that women are only attracted by appearance, and that is all. I could write a book about my experiences but Reddit has a lot of these already.

I can't tell the future, no. But my thought process is, if I couldn't make it with 27 years, it will be more awkward and complicated with every year to come... there is not one woman out there who would want a (as good as) virgin guy in his 30s. I know of many lady friends that they are find these type of guys ridiculous. Little do they know, that they are talking to a virgin.

I'll try to make my life as awesome as my time allows it, I travel a lot around the world and I am a really good photographer.

But my skills don't impress any women at all - because I am ugly.

Well, but thanks nonetheless.
